fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: The official AJOFM Covasna studies page lists a new 2026 hiring-forecast PDF ahead of the previously audited 2024 forecast. The current controlled web fetch could not open the PDF because the 21,745,921-byte document exceeded the fetch limit, so its internal methodology, sample, results and limitations were not read back in the required PDF analysis path.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: A first-party listing proves the document exists but not what its contents establish. No source-register promotion, H1-H5 point, statistic or need claim is allowed until actual PDF content can be inspected and provenance/method limits classified.

fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: Fresh official-page screening found current 2026 labour-market administration and GREEN JOBS project material, but no newly audited target-population employer survey stronger than the already retained historical S38 source.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: Project implementation, current unemployment administration and training/funding activity are context or supply evidence, not prevalence evidence for AI4WORK adult/employer needs.

fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: Fresh official-page screening of current Vâlcea/Gorj material returned labour-market administration, employment-service and project/training activity rather than a newly audited 2026 AI/digital-skills need survey for the eligible adult/employer populations.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: Administrative outcomes, offered courses and project activity are not converted into need prevalence and remain outside H1-H5 evidence.

refresh_conclusion: S39 remains the Source Register high-water mark. A potentially material first-party 2026 Covasna employer-forecast document is now explicitly tracked as DISCOVERED_UNREADABLE_NOT_PROMOTED because only its official listing could be verified in this run; no content-derived claim is made. No new H1-H5 numeric point is added and project/supply activity remains excluded as evidence of need.
next_refresh_rule: Attempt source-exact content inspection of the new Covasna 2026 PDF using an auditable PDF path. Promote only if actual readable content supplies materially stronger target-population evidence with enough provenance and methodology to classify limitations. Never promote from a listing alone.
